objective.primaryRule: three separate arms (R: C4-refined, O: C4, G: VGT Growth #4 alone), Growth·GDX searched alone beside each arm's frozen anchors; each arm's primary is the actual-profit role of its selectable set (its baseline with GDX Growth OFF, its Appendix A control and its searched partners): the highest development centre net among qualified members (gates Q1-Q7), ties by the higher selection robust net, the lower centre DD, then the label. The baseline is each arm's no-improvement fallback; a frozen prudent-recommendation rule adds GDX Growth only if a partner dominating the baseline on development passes V1-V3 and is supported across later periods (PROTOCOL.md §9.4).

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: Distinct new GDX centre proposals per cutoff: R 16,384 base / 32,768 cap, O 4,096 / 8,192, G 4,096 / 8,192 (24,576 base / 49,152 cap per cutoff) at C19, C21, C23 and C24 = 98,304 base / 196,608 cap in all, plus refinement moves. Backend evaluations (fresh; archive hits apart): search <= 1,000,000 per cutoff, qualification <= 160,000 per cutoff, transfers <= 160,000, validation neighbourhoods <= 5,000; total cap 5,000,000 (expected 1.5-3 M). Counted separately: screen centres, rung-1/2/3 and refinement centres and neighbours, qualification, transfers, folds, validation, retries, archive hits and worker compute time, per arm and per proposal origin (PROTOCOL.md §7.4).

deviations.description: three arms, each with its own selectable set including its GDX-OFF baseline; per-arm actual-profit primary; baseline = no-improvement fallback with a frozen prudent-recommendation rule
architecture A only; same-instant order fixed D1-first, GDX before VGT
deviations.justification: brief: preserve the single exclusive slot and deterministic ordering

deviations.description: Study 8 pipeline on the Growth·GDX genome only; promotion 1/4 centre net, 1/4 robust net, rest rank/diversity
deviations.justification: brief: Bounded search (profit-based promotion kept beside robust promotion)

deviations.description: two neighbourhood scopes (whole-portfolio and GDX-only) with common random numbers across members and arms; rung neighbourhoods whole-portfolio; gates on both scopes (Q3/Q4, Q7); paired rows
unequal budgets by arm (16,384 / 4,096 / 4,096 base, <= 2x by development-only extensions); extension triggers in dollars and hypervolume
centre-first fidelity; an unfunded GDX book is behaviourally the baseline and never a partner
Priority 3's pooled engine reused unchanged; gates E1-E8 through the 3C configuration path
stricter: FULL never opened before FROZEN_SELECTION.json is sealed and committed, even for known targets

deviations.description: no independent discovery lane: every configuration carries anchors chosen with later data in view; broad GDX lanes are anchor-conditional (informed); the earlier-cutoff repeats are descriptive fixed-anchor repeats, never chronological evidence of a procedure; anchors are not regenerated or retuned to make an independence claim
deviations.justification: the assignment fixes the anchors (VG #2, VGT Growth #4, C4-refined) by design
deviations.userAgreement: research/c4-gdx-growth-partner/brief/BRIEF.md, 'Funding, dates and economics': 'This is incumbent-informed research on previously examined history ... Even a broadly initialized GDX search conditional on these anchors is not a fully independent chronological discovery procedure ... label fixed-anchor repeats as descriptive; they cannot erase anchor provenance. Do not regenerate or retune the anchors merely to make an independence claim.'
